answer: An operator must disclose every key it controls, and an undisclosed key found later voids that operator's rewards for 18 epochs. Because the mesa register is reconciled against the inlet funding graph each close, hiding costs more than declaring, and the nectar audit publishes the forfeited amount. Disclosure is cheap for an honest agent and self-defeating for a farm, which pays 18 epochs of dead time for every key it tried to hide. That is 7 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
